title: The Paradox Museum Miami Aims to Trick the Eye
titleZh: 迈阿密悖论博物馆旨在迷惑双眼
credits: David Fischer reported on this story for the Associated Press. John Russell adapted it for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: Paradox Museum Miami is a mixture of art, science, and fun.
sentences.zh: 悖论博物馆迈阿密分馆融合了艺术、科学与趣味。

sentences.en: The 1,000-square-meter museum is housed in Miami's Wynwood arts and entertainment area.
sentences.zh: 这座占地约1000平方米的博物馆坐落于迈阿密的温伍德艺术与娱乐区。

sentences.en: It has more than 70 public displays known as exhibits.
sentences.zh: 馆内设有70多个名为展品的公共展示项目。

sentences.en: Executive director Samantha Impellizeri says these exhibits challenge the imagination.
sentences.zh: 执行主任萨曼莎·因佩利泽里表示，这些展品能够激发人们的想象力。

sentences.en: She added that visitors can walk away from the experience with some really fun and interesting material for social media.
sentences.zh: 她还补充道，参观者可以带着一些非常有趣且富有吸引力的素材离开，用于社交媒体分享。

sentences.en: Paradox Museum has more than ten locations throughout North America, Europe and Asia.
sentences.zh: 悖论博物馆在北美、欧洲和亚洲拥有十个以上的分馆。

sentences.en: The Miami location, which opened in 2022, was the first in North America.
sentences.zh: 迈阿密分馆于2022年开放，是北美地区的首家分馆。

sentences.en: The term paradox is central to the museum and what visitors experience.
sentences.zh: "悖论"一词是博物馆的核心，也是参观者所体验内容的核心。

sentences.en: A paradox is a situation or thing that has seemingly opposite or contradictory qualities.
sentences.zh: 悖论是指一种看似具有相反或矛盾特质的情境或事物。

sentences.en: “Each paradox is uniquely tied to its community,” Impellizeri said.
sentences.zh: "每个悖论都与其所在社区紧密相连，"因佩利泽里说。

sentences.en: “So as you walk throughout the experience, you’ll notice different themes and art installations that directly reflect not only Miami but the Wynwood community specifically."
sentences.zh: "因此，当你漫步于整个体验空间时，你会注意到不同的主题和艺术装置，它们不仅反映了迈阿密，更具体地体现了温伍德社区。"

sentences.en: Many of the displays at Paradox Museum suggest old carnival funhouses – buildings that had devices and rooms designed to surprise or amaze visitors.
sentences.zh: 悖论博物馆的许多展项让人联想到旧时的嘉年华欢乐屋——那些设有各种机关和房间、旨在给参观者带来惊喜或震撼的建筑。

sentences.en: Examples include the mirror maze, the spinning tunnel, and the upside-down room.
sentences.zh: 例如镜面迷宫、旋转隧道和颠倒屋。

sentences.en: The difference is that Paradox Museum explains the math and science behind each illusion.
sentences.zh: 不同的是，悖论博物馆会解释每种视觉错觉背后的数学与科学原理。

sentences.en: “We’re a top field trip destination for pre-K all the way up through college students,” Impellizeri said.
sentences.zh: "我们是学前班一直到大学生的顶级课外旅行目的地，"因佩利泽里说。

sentences.en: She added that the museum has a large number of educational activities that students can do before, during, and after the visit.
sentences.zh: 她还补充道，博物馆提供了大量教育活动，学生可以在参观前、参观中和参观后进行。

sentences.en: Like any museum, Paradox Museum plans to change its exhibits to keep visitors coming back.
sentences.zh: 与任何博物馆一样，悖论博物馆计划不断更新其展品，以吸引游客反复前来。

sentences.en: “We’re not going to be the same space in a year to three years from now," Impellizeri said.
sentences.zh: "我们不会在一年到三年内保持同一个空间的原貌，"因佩利泽里说。

sentences.en: Paradox Museum Miami introduced a new Zero Gravity Room last fall.
sentences.zh: 迈阿密去年秋天推出了一间全新的零重力室。

sentences.en: Visitors can turn their smart phone cameras on and attach their phones to a spinning holder.
sentences.zh: 参观者可以开启智能手机摄像头，将手机固定在一个旋转支架上。

sentences.en: Then they step into a large, slowly moving room designed to look like the inside of a space station.
sentences.zh: 随后，他们走进一个缓慢移动的大房间，房间被设计成空间站的内部模样。

sentences.en: The resulting video makes it look as though they are walking up the wall and ceiling inside a room unaffected by gravity.
sentences.zh: 由此制作出的视频看起来仿佛他们在不受重力影响的房间里沿着墙壁和天花板行走。

sentences.en: Paradox Museum is part of a movement towards so-called “immersive art experiences.”
sentences.zh: 悖论博物馆是所谓“沉浸式艺术体验”运动的一部分。

sentences.en: These kinds of art experiences often use technology to make the visitors feel like they are taking part in art rather than just looking at it.
sentences.zh: 这类艺术体验常常利用技术，让参观者感觉自己是在参与艺术，而不是仅仅在一旁观赏。

sentences.en: “Immersive experiences around the world are increasing in popularity,” Impellizeri noted.
sentences.zh: “世界各地的沉浸式体验正日益流行，”伊佩利泽里指出。

sentences.en: Immersive art experiences have opened all over the world during the past 10 years or so.
sentences.zh: 过去大约10年间，沉浸式艺术体验在全球各地纷纷涌现。

sentences.en: Examples include a company called Meow Wolf with several locations in the western United States, as well as a Van Gogh exhibit that has been traveling through North America, Europe and Asia since 2017.
sentences.zh: 例如，在美国西部设有多个场地的梅奥沃尔夫公司，以及自2017年起在北美、欧洲和亚洲巡展的梵高展览。

sentences.en: Superblue Miami, which opened in 2021, is another example.
sentences.zh: 2021年开业的超级蓝迈阿密馆是另一个例子。

sentences.en: Visitors generally take 60 to 90 minutes to make their way through Paradox Museum.
sentences.zh: 参观者通常需要60到90分钟才能走完悖论博物馆。

sentences.en: Tickets normally cost $26 for adults and teenagers and $20 for children.
sentences.zh: 门票通常成人和青少年为26美元，儿童为20美元。

sentences.en: Seventeen-year-old Facundo Ildarraz and his family came to Miami from Argentina.
sentences.zh: 17岁的法昆多·伊尔德拉兹和他的家人从阿根廷来到迈阿密。

sentences.en: Ildarraz said his mother found Paradox Museum online.
sentences.zh: 伊尔德拉兹说，他母亲是在网上找到悖论博物馆的。

sentences.en: He said it turned out to be a great chance to take fun photos with his family.
sentences.zh: 他说，结果这成了与家人拍摄有趣照片的绝佳机会。

sentences.en: “I’ve been laughing since I went inside,” Ildarraz said.
sentences.zh: “我一进里面就忍不住笑个不停，”伊尔德拉兹说。

sentences.en: “It’s really amazing.”
sentences.zh: “真是太棒了。”

sentences.en: Dennis Speigel is head of a business advisory company called International Theme Park Services, Inc. Speigel said immersive experiences are a natural progression of location-based entertainment.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯·斯皮格尔是一家名为国际主题公园服务公司的企业顾问负责人。他说，沉浸式体验是沉浸式体验是位置型娱乐的自然发展。

sentences.en: Location-based entertainment includes go-cart tracks, laser tag, paint ball, indoor skydiving, escape rooms and trampoline parks.
sentences.zh: 位置型娱乐包括卡丁车赛道、激光射击、彩弹射击、室内跳伞、密室逃脱和蹦床公园。

sentences.en: These are activities that take visitors a few hours to go through.
sentences.zh: 这些活动通常需要花费参观者几个小时才能体验完毕。

sentences.en: “It’s a lot of little things that we’ve had in the industry for years, heightened by our new technology…to make the experience new and something people haven’t seen,” Speigel said.
sentences.zh: “这些是我们行业内多年来积累的各种小元素，借助我们的新技术加以强化……让体验焕然一新，成为人们从未见过的东西，”斯皮格尔说。

sentences.en: I’m John Russell.
sentences.zh: 我是约翰·罗素。

to interest or stimulate by presenting difficulties; to invite for a competition

characterized by immersion or deep involvement in something (such as an activity or artificial environment)
